overview: A comprehensive school website featuring a hero homepage, about page, academics, news and events feed, staff directory, and contact form. Fully responsive with backend storage for news and contact submissions.
features: Hero homepage with school branding and CTAs
About page with mission and school stats
Academics page with course cards and curriculum by grade
News & Events feed with categories and detail views
Staff directory with search and department filtering
Sticky header with mobile hamburger menu
Responsive footer with links and contact info
